text:
nina: quick sync 178 — proposing a 'region-boundary' experiment as our canonical tenant isolation pattern. need alignment on launch gates, failure modes, and customer controls.

omar: agree. break down failure modes: noisy-tenant tail spikes, quota storms, and full-region failure.

tara: important: separate data-residency tenants that must never auto-failover. also call out private deployments with stricter movement rules.

nina: sketching scenarios: 1) noisy tenant doubles p99 across a zone; 2) tenant exceeds reserved capacity and needs evacuation; 3) region outage requiring controlled failover for opt-in tenants.

ben: from product feedback: customers want deterministic latency guarantees, ability to reserve capacity per-tenant, and a region-pin toggle. they'll accept higher costs for predictability.

nina: draft lightweight launch checklist:

```
Region-Boundary Experiment Checklist
- Observability: per-tenant p50/p95/p99, tail traces, eviction audit events
- Routing: tenant->region binding, affinity TTLs, overflow buckets, overflow routing policies
- Evacuation: graceful drain, KV-cache pre-warm, verification traffic window
- Compliance: region-pin toggle, explicit residency opt-in, audit logs
- Chaos tests: 15m regional outage, 2x QPS noisy-tenant spike, quota-exhaust scenario
- Rollout: canary 5 tenants -> 25 -> 100 with rollback gates
- Customer controls: API to pin/unpin, opt-in for higher-cost failover
```

omar: add SLO gates: during canary p99 <= 2x baseline and error-rate delta < 0.5%. block rollout otherwise.

tara: cost control: automatic failover blocked if estimated burst cost >3x baseline unless customer opts in to a higher cap.

ops-bot: rollout policy queued: canary-config v1 scheduled. auto-rollback if p99 > baseline*2 or error-rate >0.7% sustained for 5m.

ben: UX ask: "island preview" in Console showing projected capacity and eviction risk. mark Q2 P2.

nina: remaining decisions: manual vs automatic eviction for residency tenants, default cost cap, composition of canaries (synthetic vs real).

omar: propose residency tenants require manual eviction; default cost cap 3x, opt-in up to 10x; canaries: 5 tenants across 3 regions mixing synthetic load and low-impact real traffic.

tara: agree with mixed canaries and manual residency. also define warmup success metric: >=95% requests hitting primed KV within 5 minutes of failover.

nina: action items: I'll update RFC and playbook. @ben file Console ticket. @omar own compliance/KMS checklist. @tara build chaos scripts.

ben: filing backlog ticket and syncing with design.
omar: will draft compliance checklist and audit event schema.
tara: will script noisy-tenant and quota-exhaust scenarios.

ops-bot: reminder: add tickets to epic "region-boundary-isolation" and tag #isolation-experiment.
